title: 第13章 皇帝算计，白龙出世
slug: 刚成仙神子孙求我出山
content_zh:
“刺客定然是绝顶高手，竟能潜入皇宫，刺杀二皇子，最后还逃之夭夭，陛下震怒，全城搜捕刺客。”
陈礼感慨道，他对于二皇子没有好感，却也不反感，只是对于武林高手的实力很惊叹。
姜长生皱眉，皇宫内不是有通天境高手吗，怎能让刺客得手？
太扯了！
莫非是那些权贵所为？
可皇帝能允许那些家伙对自己另一个儿子出手？
姜长生问道：“二殿下没有大碍吧？”
陈礼道：“说是重伤，应该不会要命，否则洪大将军非得发疯不可，二殿下的母亲可不是善茬。”
姜长生突然看不懂皇帝了。
上次与清虚道长聊后，他猜测自己被调包很可能是皇帝所为，天大的权贵除了皇帝，还有更大的？
若是皇帝所为，那就好解释了，皇宫内高手如云，想要将他带出去，何其难，若是皇帝睁一只眼闭一只眼，那就能解释得通，但皇帝放任那些人对自己另一位儿子出手，这是什么意思？
他非要将自己的儿子斩尽杀绝，莫非他这位皇帝才是真正被调包的？
到现在，姜长生也想不明白皇帝为何要让人将他调包。
“听闻你将那妖道弄伤，干得痛快，妖道受伤后，陛下就很少再见他，不过最近陛下一个月上朝四五次，不知在宫里搞些什么，如今二殿下又受伤，朝堂人心浮动，宰相竟然趁机想让太子监国，真是荒唐，若来日父子二人出现间隙，那江山岂不是要动荡？”
陈礼提起朝堂上的事情便义愤填膺，根本不忌讳皇帝、太子。
姜长生问道：“陛下同意了吗？”
陈礼道：“不清楚，当日，陛下并没有上朝，三省的大人们将事情告诉陛下后便没有了后音。”
大景朝实行三省六部之制，与华夏的某些朝代很像，但又有些不同，三省分别为中书省、门下省和尚书省，地位高于六部，皆是二品重臣，直面皇帝，而宰相乃三省之首，与三省同级，但在权力上要高于三省的重臣们。
姜长生好奇问道：“陈大哥，你呢，到底支持哪位皇子？”
在朝做官，岂能不站队？

陈礼道：“我自然是尊太子，自古以来，嫡长子为首乃正道，只是太子提前掌权，患大于利。”
你他娘的竟然是太子党！
姜长生无语，不过陈礼应该不是与他为敌，否则也不会说出那么多大逆不道的话。
“说起来，陛下对太子殿下的态度时好时坏，近些年来，甚至开始冷落皇后娘娘，或许陛下开始忌惮皇后娘娘的派系。”陈礼感慨道。
姜长生问道：“皇后娘娘的派系很强？”
皇宫里的事，他在道观内很难了解，清虚道长也不会多说。
陈礼叹气道：“岂止是强，已经能撼动国本，京城驻扎的禁军之首乃皇后娘娘的兄长，三省之中有两位是皇后娘娘的弟弟，陛下当年起事，靠的就是杨家，陛下娶了皇后娘娘，杨家鼎力支持，方才有钱财招兵买马，那时的杨家乃一方巨贾，倾尽家财，支持陛下，男儿给陛下当兵当将，才子给陛下当谋士，潮起潮落，无论陛下胜败，杨家一直跟随，是陛下最信任的力量，直到帮陛下打下这大大的江山。”
姜长生恍然大悟，突然明白皇帝为何要调包他。
他对假太子也产生了一丝同情。
这家伙注定悲剧！
皇帝调包他，有朝一日再揭露假太子并非亲生，不就能废太子？
杨家虽怒，却也找不到真太子，只能放任其他皇子登基，杨家就会被逐步削弱。
不过杨家还有一张底牌，那就是四皇子姜誉。
那姜誉……
姜长生心寒，虎毒不食子，可他的父皇真够狠辣的。
大景以信义为国本，皇帝当初许诺打下江山，与杨家共分天下，自然不能直接灭了杨家，他需要手段，需要理由。
这些年落马的重臣谁不是被按了造反、欺压百姓等等罪名，正因如此，皇帝仍没有丢掉信义，是那些臣子作死。
陈礼又跟姜长生聊了一炷香时间，他离去后，姜长生仍在屋内想着心事。
帝王之家没有亲情，原来不是空话。
姜长生心中感慨，他对当皇帝没有兴趣，现在让他当皇帝，他都不知该如何管理王朝，但被这样算计，即便是自己的父亲，他仍不爽。

还是那句话，此仇不报，非君子！
姜长生的眼神闪烁，渐渐有了一个大胆的想法。
皇宫，二皇子的寝宫内。
头发半白的姜渊坐在床边，望着床上的姜明，满脸心疼之色，姜明已经醒来，但脸上毫无血色，嘴唇干裂，与当日在龙起观的意气风发相比，判若两人。
“明儿，以后少出去，虽天下已定，但前朝余孽仍在，明白吗？”
姜渊拍着姜明的手背，忧虑叹气。
姜明咬牙道：“可我不是在宫外遭遇行刺，我……”
姜渊瞪眼，沉声喝道：“你在龙起观的所作所为还不够威风？朕都不敢完全保一个人，你身为皇子就敢永保一人，旁人听了岂不觉得你嚣张？”
“还放话给整个京城，荒唐！”
闻言，姜明冷汗直流。
在姜渊身后，有一人，正是太子姜乾，他气质儒雅，好似书生，没有姜誉、姜明的意气。
姜乾开口道：“父皇，二弟只是逞口舌之快，并无他心，况且，他身负伤势，父皇何必吓唬他？”
姜明向他投去一个感激的眼神。
姜渊瞥了姜乾一眼，哼道：“你啊，就知道纵容弟弟们。”
姜乾笑了笑，没有再接话。
在姜乾身后的老太监是常年跟随姜渊左右的李公公，也是他将姜长生送出的皇宫。
李公公弯着腰，道：“陛下，时辰已到，该问天了。”
姜渊一听，甩了甩袖子，站起身来，双手叉腰，笑道：“好好养伤吧，来年运河初具规模，朕带你们二人下江南，从小到大，你们还未出过京城，朕带你们瞧瞧朕打下来的大好江山。”
说罢，姜渊拂袖离去，龙行虎步，李公公连忙跟上。
姜乾摇头失笑，看向床上的姜明，笑道：“二弟，你好好养伤，我也得去忙了。”

他刚转身，姜明的声音飘来，让他止步。
“大哥，你说会不会是宫内有人想我死？”
他的语气耐人寻味，目光盯着上方，没有看向姜乾。
姜乾微微转头，侧脸对着姜明，道：“二弟，少看些史书，我们姜家乃真龙之家，岂会自相残杀，我会亲自调查，我也不会允许这样的事发生。”
说罢，他抬步走出房门。
姜明露出讥讽笑容，然后缓缓闭目。
二皇子受伤后便没有再派人来送礼，姜长生也乐得清闲，可以专心练功。
一个月后，蛇蛋终于孵化，一条白色小蛇现身，比姜长生的小拇指还细，有近十公分长，刚出生的它与寻常小蛇没有区别，姜长生不得不亲自照顾它，连投喂都尽量小心，生怕把它噎死。
这一年，姜长生没有再遇到危险，二皇子没有前来拜访他，那些与他为敌的权贵也没有再派人刺杀他。
开元十八年！
这一年，皇帝携太子、二皇子乘船入运河，下江南。
运河自北向南，仍在建设中，但已经修成大半，足可乘船运行。
皇帝离京乃是大事，龙起观弟子也得知此事，姜长生还是听青苦说的，自立国起，皇帝还是首次离京。
姜长生倒是不在意，若是皇帝不在意，那些权贵来袭，正好给他送生存奖励。
他每日大部分时间都花在道法自然功上，灵力磅礴，绝顶高手与他相比，说是他的千分之一，已然是夸奖。
这一日，院内。
姜长生坐在门槛上，面前站着两名孩童，皆是六岁，一男一女，道袍披在他们身上，显得宽松，但也让他们显得更加可爱。
仔细看去，两名道童一动不动，瞳孔竟然泛着淡淡的金光，极为诡异。
反观姜长生，他双眸呈金色，即便是大白天，也显得耀眼，他正在施展幻神瞳，篡改两位道童的记忆。
他突然闭目，再次睁眼时，瞳孔恢复正常，两名道童跟着惊醒。

女道童俏生生的问道：“长生师兄，你怎么停下来了？”
这便是姜长生给他们改变的记忆，让他们误以为自己在听道，实则他们才刚到，姜长生压根还未讲道。
男道童挠了挠头，同样困惑。
姜长生笑道：“没什么，今日就到此为止吧，你们明日再来，我教你们一些武功。”
两人一听，顿时欢呼，然后离去。
待他们离开院子，姜长生长出一口气，只是给两名孩童改了一段近五分钟的记忆便让他有些头晕，这幻神瞳的副作用真是强。
姜长生并没有失落，反而振奋，只要他足够强大，他是不是可以直接改变一个人对前半生的记忆，从而扭转其性格，甚至将其为自己所用？
太霸道了！
一条白蛇从姜长生的后颈冒出，对着他的脸颊吐着蛇信，显得极为亲近。
大半年过去，白蛇已经快有半米长，它性格温和，通人性，姜长生给其取名为白龙，期待着它有朝一日能化龙。
当日傍晚，陈礼前来拜访。
“长生，你可得小心点，陛下离京，如今京城内暗流涌动，我陈家的江湖儿郎打听到魔门准备入京，很可能是要为鬼目邪王报仇。”陈礼语气严肃，脸上满是忧虑之色。
content_en:
"The assassin must be an extremely skilled person. He was able to sneak into the palace, assassinate the second prince, and finally escape. Your Majesty was furious and the entire city was searching for the assassin."
Chen Li sighed with emotion. He didn't like the second prince, but he didn't dislike him either. He was just amazed by the strength of the martial arts master.
Jiang Changsheng frowned, wasn't there a Tongtian realm master in the palace? How could the assassin succeed?
That’s ridiculous!
Could it be that those powerful people did it?
But can the emperor allow those guys to take action against his other son?
Jiang Changsheng asked: "Is your Second Highness okay?"
Chen Li said: "It is said to be a serious injury, but it should not be fatal, otherwise General Hong would have gone crazy. His Highness's mother is not a kind person."
Jiang Changsheng suddenly couldn't understand the emperor.
After chatting with Taoist Priest Qingxu last time, he guessed that his transfer was probably the result of the emperor. Besides the emperor, who else is bigger?
If it was the emperor who did it, it would be easy to explain. There are so many masters in the palace, and it would be so difficult to take him out. If the emperor turned a blind eye, it would make sense. But what does the emperor mean by letting those people take action against his other son?
He insisted on killing all his sons. Could it be that he, the emperor, was the one who was really transferred?
Until now, Jiang Changsheng still couldn't figure out why the emperor asked someone to transfer him.
"I heard that you injured the evildoer and had a great time. After the evildoer was injured, His Majesty rarely saw him. However, recently, His Majesty went to court four or five times a month, and I don't know what he was doing in the palace. Now His Highness is injured again, and the people in the court are confused. The prime minister actually took the opportunity to want the prince to supervise the country. It is really ridiculous. If there is a gap between father and son in the future, won't the country be in turmoil?"
Chen Li was filled with indignation when he mentioned things in the court, and he had no taboo against the emperor or the prince at all.
Jiang Changsheng asked: "Does Your Majesty agree?"
Chen Li said: "I don't know. Your Majesty did not go to court that day. The adults from the three provinces told your Majesty the matter and there was no follow-up."
The Jing Dynasty implemented a system of three provinces and six ministries, which was very similar to some dynasties in China, but was somewhat different. The three provinces were Zhongshu Province, Menxia Province and Shangshu Province. Their status was higher than that of the six ministries. They were all second-rank ministers who faced the emperor directly. The prime minister was the head of the three provinces and was at the same level as the three provinces, but had higher power than the ministers of the three provinces.
Jiang Changsheng asked curiously: "Brother Chen, what about you, which prince do you support?"
When you are an official in the government, how can you not take sides?
Chen Li said: "Of course I respect the prince. Since ancient times, it is the right way for the eldest son to be the first. However, when the prince takes power in advance, the disadvantages outweigh the benefits."
You are a fucking princeling!
Jiang Changsheng was speechless, but Chen Li probably wasn't his enemy, otherwise he wouldn't have said so many treacherous words.
"Speaking of which, His Majesty's attitude towards His Royal Highness the Crown Prince has been good and bad. In recent years, he has even begun to neglect the Queen. Perhaps His Majesty has begun to be afraid of the Queen's faction." Chen Li said with emotion.
Jiang Changsheng asked: "The Queen's faction is very strong?"
It was difficult for him to understand the affairs in the palace in the Taoist temple, and Taoist Master Qingxu would not say much.
Chen Li sighed and said: "Not only is he strong, he has been able to shake the country. The head of the imperial army stationed in the capital is the empress's brother. Two of the three provinces are the empress's brothers. His majesty relied on the Yang family for his rebellion. His majesty married the empress, and the Yang family gave her full support, so he had money. When it came to recruiting soldiers and horses, the Yang family was a wealthy businessman who spent all their wealth to support Your Majesty. Their sons served as soldiers and generals for Your Majesty, and their talented men served as Your Majesty's counselors. Regardless of whether His Majesty won or lost, the Yang family always followed him and became His Majesty's most trusted force until he helped Your Majesty conquer this great empire. "
Jiang Changsheng suddenly realized why the emperor wanted to transfer him.
He also felt a tinge of sympathy for the false prince.
This guy is doomed to tragedy!
The emperor manipulated him and one day revealed that the false prince was not his biological son. Wouldn't he be able to depose the prince?
Yang JiajuanHe was angry, but he couldn't find the true prince, so he could only allow other princes to ascend the throne, and the Yang family would be gradually weakened.
But the Yang family still has a trump card, and that is the fourth prince Jiang Yu.
That Jiang Yu...
Jiang Changsheng was heartbroken, as a tiger cannot eat its own children, but his father was really ruthless.
Da Jing regards loyalty as the foundation of his country. The emperor originally promised to conquer the country and share the world with the Yang family. Naturally, he could not directly destroy the Yang family. He needed means and reasons.
All the important ministers who have been dismissed in recent years have been accused of rebellion, oppression of the people, etc. Because of this, the emperor still has not lost his faith. It is those ministers who seek death.
Chen Li chatted with Jiang Changsheng for another while. After he left, Jiang Changsheng was still thinking about something in the room.
It turns out that there is no family affection in the imperial family. It turns out that it is not empty talk.
Jiang Changsheng lamented in his heart that he had no interest in being the emperor. Now that he was asked to be the emperor, he didn't know how to manage the dynasty. But even if it was his own father, he was not happy with being plotted like this.
As the saying goes, if you don't take revenge, you are not a gentleman!
Jiang Changsheng's eyes flickered, and he gradually came up with a bold idea.
In the palace, the second prince's bedroom.
Jiang Yuan, who had half-white hair, sat on the edge of the bed and looked at Jiang Ming on the bed with a look of distress on his face. Jiang Ming had woken up, but his face was bloodless and his lips were chapped. Compared with the high-spirited man at Longqiguan that day, he looked completely different.
"Tomorrow, don't go out anymore. Although the world has been settled, the remnants of the previous dynasty are still there. Do you understand?"
Jiang Yuan patted the back of Jiang Ming's hand and sighed worriedly.
Jiang Ming gritted his teeth and said, "But I was not assassinated outside the palace. I..."
Jiang Yuan glared and shouted in a deep voice: "What you did in Longqiguan wasn't majestic enough? I don't dare to protect someone completely. As a prince, you dare to protect someone forever. Wouldn't others think you are arrogant?"
“And you’re telling the whole capital, that’s ridiculous!”
Hearing this, Jiang Ming broke into a cold sweat.
Behind Jiang Yuan, there was a person, the prince Jiang Qian. He had a refined temperament, like a scholar, and did not have the spirit of Jiang Yu or Jiang Ming.
Jiang Gan said: "Father, my second brother is just talking and has no other intentions. Besides, he is injured, why should father scare him?"
Jiang Ming cast a grateful look at him.
Jiang Yuan glanced at Jiang Gan and hummed: "You know how to pamper your brothers."
Jiang Gan smiled and didn't answer any more.
The old eunuch behind Jiang Gan is Eunuch Li who has been with Jiang Yuan all year round, and it was he who sent Jiang Changsheng out of the palace.
Eunuch Li bent down and said, "Your Majesty, the time has come. It's time to ask Heaven."
Upon hearing this, Jiang Yuan shook off his sleeves, stood up, put his hands on his hips, and said with a smile: "Take good care of yourself. The canal will begin to take shape in the coming year. I will take you two down to the south of the Yangtze River. Since you were young, you have never left the capital. I will show you the great country I conquered."
After saying that, Jiang Yuan fluttered his sleeves and left. Eunuch Li quickly followed.
Jiang Qian shook his head and laughed, looked at Jiang Ming on the bed, and said with a smile: "Second brother, you take good care of yourself, I have to go and do some work."
As soon as he turned around, Jiang Ming's voice floated over and stopped him.
"Brother, do you think there is someone in the palace who wants me to die?"
His tone was intriguing, and he stared upward without looking at Jiang Qian.
Jiang Gan turned his head slightly, turned his face to Jiang Ming, and said, "Second brother, stop reading the history books. Our Jiang family is the family of true dragons. How can we kill each other? I will personally investigate and I will not allow such a thing to happen."
After that, he walked out of the door.
Jiang Ming smiled sarcastically, then slowly closed his eyes.
After the second prince was injured, he no longer sent anyone to deliver gifts. Jiang Changsheng was also happy to be free and could concentrate on practicing.
A month later, the snake eggs finally hatched, and a small white snake appeared. It was thinner than Jiang Changsheng's little finger and nearly ten centimeters long. When it was born, it was no different from an ordinary snake. Jiang Changsheng had to take care of it personally, even feeding it as carefully as possible, for fear of choking it to death.
This year, Jiang Changsheng neverWhen he was in danger, the second prince did not come to visit him, and the powerful people who were his enemies did not send anyone to assassinate him.
The eighteenth year of Kaiyuan!
This year, the emperor, the prince, and the second prince took a boat into the canal and went down to the south of the Yangtze River.
The canal runs from north to south and is still under construction, but it is mostly completed and can be operated by boats.
The emperor's departure from the capital was a big event, and Long Qiguan's disciples also learned about it. Jiang Changsheng still listened to Qing Ku's words. This was the first time the emperor left the capital since the founding of the country.
Jiang Changsheng didn't care. If the emperor didn't care, those powerful people would come and give him a survival reward.
He spends most of his time on Taoist natural skills every day, and his spiritual power is so majestic that compared to the top masters, saying he is one thousandth of his strength is already a compliment.
On this day, in the courtyard.
Jiang Changsheng sat on the threshold, with two children standing in front of him, both six years old, one boy and one girl. The Taoist robes were draped on them, making them look loose, but it also made them look more adorable.
Looking carefully, the two Taoist boys were motionless, and their pupils were glowing with a faint golden light, which was extremely strange.
On the other hand, Jiang Changsheng's eyes were golden and dazzling even in broad daylight. He was using the Phantom Eyes to tamper with the memories of the two Taoist boys.
He suddenly closed his eyes, and when he opened them again, his pupils returned to normal, and the two Taoist boys woke up.
The female Taoist boy asked playfully: "Brother Changsheng, why did you stop?"
This was the memory that Jiang Changsheng changed for them, making them mistakenly think that they were listening to the sermon. In fact, they had just arrived and Jiang Changsheng had not preached at all.
The male Taoist boy scratched his head, equally confused.
Jiang Changsheng smiled and said: "It's nothing. That's it for today. Come back tomorrow and I'll teach you some martial arts."
When the two heard this, they cheered immediately and left.
When they left the yard, Jiang Changchang breathed a sigh of relief. Just changing the memory of the two children for nearly five minutes made him feel dizzy. The side effects of the Phantom Eyes were really strong.
Jiang Changsheng was not disappointed, but instead inspired. As long as he was strong enough, could he directly change a person's memory of the first half of his life, thereby reversing his character, or even use it for himself?
Too domineering!
A white snake emerged from the back of Jiang Changsheng's neck, spitting a snake message into his face, appearing extremely close to him.
More than half a year later, the white snake was almost half a meter long. It had a gentle personality and was humane. Jiang Changsheng named it White Dragon, hoping that one day it could transform into a dragon.
In the evening of that day, Chen Li came to visit.
"Chang Sheng, you have to be careful. Your Majesty has left the capital. Now there are undercurrents surging in the capital. The charlatans of my Chen family have heard that the Demon Sect is preparing to enter the capital. They may want to avenge the Ghost Eyed Evil King." Chen Li spoke seriously, with a look of worry on his face.
